description: The installer/build pipeline parses every program entry from the supplied master list, preserves its original numbered category/categories, removes exact duplicate names for the selectable program list, and assigns additional package tags.

full.name: Full
full.sizeRule: Use real components/downloads only; never pad the package.

tagRules.gaming: Gaming optimization/performance, game engines, game development, game audio, game debugging/profiling, game modding and game asset categories.
tagRules.overclocking: GPU overclocking/control, CPU/RAM/motherboard tuning, hardware monitoring and gaming performance categories, plus recognized tuning/monitoring tools.
tagRules.video: Video editing, advanced video, screen recording/streaming, AI image/video and video-creator categories, plus recognized video tools.
tagRules.photo: Image editing/graphics and Photo/RAW categories, plus recognized image/RAW tools.
tagRules.development: Game-engine, game-development, programming, SDK/toolchain and developer-tool categories.

licensingPolicy: Entries marked trial/paid/availability varies remain visible but must not be silently redistributed as free binaries. The installer should prefer official vendor/developer download sources.
